reviewNotes: Twenty-five birthday reactions, hurt responses, unhappy-spouse dialogue, adoption lines, and pregnancy dialogue were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover exact slash variants and dialogue tokens, action markup, placeholders, gender-neutral speaker phrasing, emotional tone, punctuation, and natural conversational Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.
